evidence: Modifies src/index/base.* and src/index/txindex.* to support running txindex alongside pruning via an updated prune policy and virtual block references.
rationale: Removes the long-standing mutual exclusion between -txindex and -prune, allowing storage-constrained nodes to index transactions without keeping hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history on disk. It also enables pruned nodes to track starting height and surface candidate block hashes for on-demand retrieval.
